description: Figure tracks of the handheld match (scripts/own-video-figures.py scores, scripts/own-video-figure-paths.py Viterbi), every frame of the 5:00 match. Per figure and frame: u = slot position 0-1 along the slot centreline (data/geometry.json), heading_deg = facing direction in world degrees (0 = +x, counter-clockwise; the team's home heading is W 0, E 180), x_mm/y_mm = pivot on the slot centreline, score = mean kit-map value at the projected mold (0-1; below 0.1 the figure is barely supported), flip_margin = score minus the score of the opposite heading (near 0: front and back cannot be told apart).

kits.evidence: out/own-video/kit-test.json: 11 of 12 slots score higher with this kit (E-G does not)
